title: Capital Structure Analysis and Presentation
learning_objectives: Calculate weighted average cost of capital

simple.definition: Only common stock (no potentially dilutive securities)

complex.definition: Has potentially dilutive securities (options, warrants, convertible bonds, convertible preferred)
complex.eps_reporting: Report both basic AND diluted EPS

stockholders_equity_presentation.alternative_formats: May present contributed capital, retained earnings, and AOCI separately or combined

required: Number of shares authorized, issued, outstanding for each class

debt_vs_equity_classification.debt_characteristics: Fixed maturity, mandatory payments, legal obligation, not ownership
debt_vs_equity_classification.equity_characteristics: No maturity, discretionary dividends, residual interest, ownership
debt_vs_equity_classification.judgment_required: Some instruments (mandatorily redeemable preferred, certain warrants) require analysis per ASC 480

weighted_average_cost_of_capital.concept: Blended cost of debt and equity financing (corporate finance concept, not GAAP)
weighted_average_cost_of_capital.formula: WACC = (Weight of debt × After-tax cost of debt) + (Weight of equity × Cost of equity)
weighted_average_cost_of_capital.not_gaap_reporting: WACC is valuation/finance concept, not financial statement measurement

book_value_per_share.calculation: (Total stockholders' equity - Preferred equity) / Common shares outstanding
book_value_per_share.purpose: Indicates net asset value attributable to each common share
book_value_per_share.example: Total equity $1M. Preferred stock $100K. Common shares 50K. Book value per share = ($1M - $100K) / 50K = $18 per share

contributed_capital_vs_retained_earnings.retained_earnings: Capital from operations (cumulative net income - dividends)
contributed_capital_vs_retained_earnings.legal_capital: Par value of issued shares (minimum required by state law in some jurisdictions)

treasury_stock_impact.shares: Reduces outstanding shares but not issued shares
treasury_stock_impact.cost_method: Most common (record at cost paid to reacquire)

example_equity_section.format:
Stockholders' Equity:
Preferred stock, $10 par, 10,000 shares authorized, 5,000 issued and outstanding $50,000
Common stock, $1 par, 100,000 shares authorized, 50,000 issued, 48,000 outstanding $50,000
Additional paid-in capital $200,000
Retained earnings $300,000
Accumulated other comprehensive income $20,000
Less: Treasury stock, 2,000 shares at cost (30,000)
Total stockholders' equity $590,000

restrictions_on_retained_earnings.disclosure: Disclosed in notes (does not reduce reported RE balance, but restricts use for dividends)
restrictions_on_retained_earnings.appropriation: May formally appropriate RE (create separate RE account for restriction)

cpa_exam_tips: Simple capital structure: Only common stock. Report basic EPS only.
Complex capital structure: Has potentially dilutive securities. Report basic AND diluted EPS.
Equity presentation order: Preferred stock, Common stock, APIC, RE, AOCI, (Treasury stock)
Treasury stock: Contra-equity, reduces outstanding shares
Book value per share = (Total equity - Preferred equity) / Common shares outstanding
Restricted RE: Disclose in notes, doesn't reduce reported balance

key_points: Simple capital structure: Only common stock, report basic EPS only
Complex capital structure: Has dilutive securities, report basic and diluted EPS
Equity presentation: PS, CS, APIC, RE, AOCI, less Treasury Stock
Treasury stock: Contra-equity, reduces outstanding (not issued) shares
Book value per share: (Total equity - Preferred) / Common shares outstanding
Restricted RE: Disclosed in notes, doesn't reduce reported balance
